items.title: Coinbase stock sinks as weak crypto market leads to another quarterly loss
items.summary: Coinbase Global stock tumbled early Friday after the company posted a wider-than-expected second quarter net loss on Thursday, marking its third quarter in the red since the crypto market began to draw down from its October highs.

items.title: COIN Q2 Deep Dive: Revenue Miss, Exec Turnover, and Product Diversification Take Center Stage
items.summary: Blockchain infrastructure company Coinbase (NASDAQ:COIN) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales falling 18.5% year on year to $1.22 billion. Its non-GAAP loss of $1.36 per share was significantly below analysts’ consensus estimates.
